scope: Three existing Tantalus DLC archives recovered from the Yautja The Long Hunt folder. Their bytes are preserved without changes.
limitations: All 36 PNG files are historical documentation: 21 screenshots, 9 scene previews and 6 sprite-sheet previews; they are not 36 new runtime sprites.
These packages remain standalone prototypes or light integrations; no GameEngine, SaveSystem or main-menu integration is performed by this archival import.
Badlands documents its SVG drawings as stylized placeholders, not visual 1:1 replicas.
Wolf has an older internal README.txt v0.5 while README_INSTALL.md describes v0.7. Preserve both as historical records.
Historical QA reports inside these archives are preserved, not newly executed or certified by this import.

previousRecovery.note: The prior archive directory was untracked and its upload checkpoint contained one payload blob only. This import neither publishes nor replaces that corpus.

verification.method: Read every ZIP member, verify ZIP CRC, calculate archive and member SHA-256, reject unsafe paths and symlinks. No archive code executed.
